review: Independent source review by the core/deployment agent of the separately implemented local route checker.
reviewedBoundaries: Fixed public diagnostic endpoint and default profile; no model-supplied URL or credential.
Explicit HTTP CONNECT with no startup request, direct fallback or redirect.
TLS hostname/certificate verification, nonce/IP-only response and byte/time limits.
Credential isolation from origin/output and debug/TLS environment rejection.
Cancellation, concurrency limit and socket/agent cleanup.
limits: Controlled local proxy and HTTPS fixtures only; no live supplier or public endpoint validation.
A successful route check describes one request from one local process, not other tools or a claimed proxy type/location.
Deployment Caddy peer-header trust and host isolation require separate real-host validation.
